subject.title: fix(ui): follow Gateway queue mode for active-run messages

question: Should existing browser scopes whose legacy settings omit `chatFollowUpMode` preserve the prior `steer` behavior, or immediately reinterpret absence as Gateway inheritance on upgrade?
rationale: The old persistence format intentionally omitted the default `steer` value, so code cannot distinguish a user who selected steer from one who accepted the old default; changing that interpretation requires explicit upgrade-policy ownership.

options.title: Preserve legacy scopes
options.body: Migrate existing scoped settings without the key to an explicit `steer` override while using server inheritance for fresh scopes and reset actions.

options.title: Accept immediate inheritance
options.body: Treat all missing legacy values as server inheritance, document the behavior change, and provide real fresh-install and upgrade proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Preserve legacy scopes
recommendation.body: Migrate existing scoped settings without the key to an explicit `steer` override while using server inheritance for fresh scopes and reset actions.

likelyOwner.reason: This person co-authored the existing follow-up preference behavior and is the strongest available owner for its upgrade semantics.
